objects.description: [NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has been delivered using malicious links from phishing emails and SMS messages as well as malicious websites that mimic Czech banks.(Citation: ESETStefankoOsmani_NGate_Aug2024)(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025) [NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has also been distributed through a website impersonating a Brazilian lottery (“Rio de Prêmios”) and a fake Google Play web page (“Proteção Cartão”).(Citation: ESETStefanko_NGateVariant_Apr2026)
